decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The use hereby permitted shall be for a limited period, being the period of 2 years from the date of this decision. The building hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition. 
Reason: The proposal is not considered suitable as a permanent form of development to To ensure the continued safe operation of the Strategic Road Network and the character and appearance of the area.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [1218-A-SC-01, 1218-A-SC-02, 1218-A-SC-04, 1218-A-SC-05, 1218-A-SC-06, 1218-A-SC-07, 1218-A-SC-08, 1218-A-SC-09, 1218-A-SC-10, 2007-445b-No.3a - A110 C1 received 20/06/2025
1218-A-SC-03- Rev 01, 218-A-SC-04 Rev 01 received 09/12/2025 
].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - Before any works above ground level take place, a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority; the boundary treatment shall be erected as approved before the development is first brought into use and retained as such thereafter.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and area.

Condition : 4 - No development pursuant to this application shall commence until a detailed Construction Management Plan and Working Method Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with the Highway Authority for the M4 motorway). Construction of the development shall then be carried out in accordance with the agreed Construction Management Plan and Working Method Statement. The Construction Management Plan will include information about, but not be limited to;-
�	Craneage details and an agreed lift plan
�	Confirmation that an agreement is in place for the continued access and inspection works related to the M4 motorway
�	Agreement on reinstatement works once the temporary building is place
�	Agreement on the need for ongoing discussion regarding methods for removing the building at the end of the temporary permission
Reason: To ensure the continued safe operation of the Strategic Road Network in line with requirement set out in DfT Circular 01/2022.

Condition : 5 - Prior to and during construction installation of the temporary single storey building and during the occupation and use of the building and thereafter, no undertakings must interfere with or prevent full 24-hour access to any part of the adjacent M4 structures and related assets drainage, including the full M4 pier heights, associated crossheads and drainage systems.
Reason: To ensure the continued safe operation of the Strategic Road Network in line with requirement set out in DfT Circular 01/2022

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a [finalised] Travel Plan in accordance with current Council and TfL guidance comprising immediate, continuing and long-term measures to promote and encourage a reduction in car use shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved Travel Plan shall be implemented upon occupation, and thereafter monitored and reviewed in accordance with the agreed Travel Plan targets and timescales to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
 Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives, including a reduction in single occupancy car journeys and the increased use of public transport, walking and cycling.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to occupation, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle stands for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall be fully implemented and made available for use before any part of the development is first occupied and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
description: Erection of a single storey building to be used as a marketing suite with associated landscaping for a temporary period of 2 years
